description: Remove ComingSoon repo-wide and confirm no residue, then do a final integration pass confirming auth/Shell and existing zone/record CRUD are intact. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 having rewritten every former ComingSoon importer (dashboard, health-checks, traffic-policies, profiles) — once those are real pages, the component and the /coming-soon and /resolver routes can be deleted safely.
steps: Optionally remove the now-unused .coming-soon CSS rules in c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\globals.css (harmless to leave; remove only if nothing references them).
Run a repo-wide grep over frontend/src for 'Coming soon', 'coming-soon', and 'ComingSoon' and confirm zero matches and that no page imports ComingSoon.

Confirm Shell.tsx and AuthProvider are untouched (Shell still renders children bare while loading or !user; login page unchanged). Run `npm run build` once more; then start the backend + `npm run dev`, log in admin/admin, and smoke every section plus zone edit/delete and DNS record create/edit/delete.
acceptance_criteria: A repo-wide search over frontend/src for 'Coming soon', 'coming-soon', and 'ComingSoon' returns zero matches, and the /coming-soon and /resolver routes no longer exist.
Running `npm run build` in frontend exits 0 with no TypeScript errors (no dangling ComingSoon import anywhere).

Logging in and out still work, unauthenticated users still see the bare login page (Shell renders children bare while loading/!user), and zone edit/delete + DNS record CRUD still function via their modals.
verification: grep -r -i 'coming soon' and grep -r 'ComingSoon' and grep -r 'coming-soon' over frontend/src -> expect zero matches
Browser (admin/admin): log out + back in works; unauthenticated -> /login; edit a zone, delete a zone, and create/edit/delete a DNS record all still succeed.
findings: DONE. Deleted frontend/src/components/ComingSoon.tsx and the folders frontend/src/app/coming-soon and frontend/src/app/resolver. Removed the now-unused .coming-soon CSS block from globals.css (nothing referenced it). Shell.tsx and AuthProvider untouched (Shell still renders children bare while loading or !user); backend/lib not touched. Repo-wide grep over frontend/src for 'Coming soon', 'coming-soon', and 'ComingSoon' returns ZERO matches. `npm run build` exits 0 (TypeScript clean, 22 routes; /coming-soon and /resolver no longer present). Note: the first build surfaced stale .next/dev/types/validator.ts references to the deleted routes; deleting the uncommitted .next build-output dir and rebuilding resolved it cleanly.
